body: Fix spec android-macos-e2e-fixes, phases 8 and 9.U+000AU+000AWritten:U+000AU+002D docs/specs/android-macos-e2e-fixes.md: 48 acceptance criteria.U+000AU+002D docs/specs/android-macos-e2e-fixes.items.json: 35 Steps in 11 groups that ship together.U+000AU+002D docs/specs/android-macos-e2e-fixes.repro.dart.U+000ABoth interphase checkers pass.U+000AU+000AThe spec reviewer found 16 issues. The main fixes:U+000AU+002D The photo removal Step's pinned tests are now listed.U+000AU+002D The recorder cleanup is proven in the recorder tests rather than through fakes.U+000AU+002D Menu Undo takes its state from the editor's UndoHistoryController.U+000AU+002D The app-level Ctrl+K layer acts only inside an EditableText.U+000AU+002D The clocks Step now includes compact_log_card.dart and is ordered after the pill Step.U+000AU+002D The reminder permission flag's persistence files are listed.U+000AU+002D The keyboard Steps share one Tab-reach check run over named sweep states.U+000AU+000AAssumptions added: controls drawn inside a note get no separate Tab stop; the macOS Help menu is dropped; every Step is built on d36b748, which means the owner's local checkout (4031189) must be updated first. Waiting on the reviewer's re-check, then owner approval of the written spec.
